title: Just when you think Musk has reached peak cringe, he takes it up a notch by describing AI music as 'awesome-core' – 21 totally human-made burns
key_facts: The Poke, a UK humour site, writes about a clip from "the X Takeover event in Texas" in which Elon Musk talks about AI music videos.
In the clip he says: "Calling it slop-core is a misnomer, frankly… it's awesome-core."
An X account posted the clip, and replies mocking Musk followed; the article is a roundup of those replies.
The Poke gives no date for the event; the embedded posts are dated 11 Oct 2026.
The article is opinionated humour; the only factual claim is the remark itself, which rests on the clip.
quote_evidence: There's absolutely nothing about this clip from the X Takeover event in Texas to make us think otherwise.
"Calling it slop-core is a misnomer, frankly… it's awesome-core."
When one Musk-licking account posted it on Twitter, the pisstaking began in earnest.
why_it_matters_hint: A remark by a prominent AI backer on AI music draws online mockery; no policy or product is involved.
event_date: Embedded posts dated 11 Oct 2026; event date not stated
notes: Humour site; the clip itself was not seen. Satire and reaction, not analysis.
